method: read-only transaction receipt + block isolation + sender EVM-balance delta
limitations: One configured PortalDot RPC was queried; the RPC operator was not independently authenticated.
The receipt-derived cost is gasUsed × effectiveGasPrice. The balance delta is the reconciliation check; this report does not guess a fee/storage-deposit breakdown.

This proves the sender's total EVM-balance decrease for the isolated transaction block on the configured RPC. It does not independently authenticate the RPC operator and does not break the debit into runtime execution fee versus storage-deposit components.
note: The sender's EVM-balance decrease equals gasUsed × effectiveGasPriceWei for this isolated block.
